card.title: Still a Good Sign
card.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our first dinner since the breakup, and you still groan at my waiter joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered. We've still got our little traditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat in silence? I don't want another awful joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still know how to ask me for what you need. I'll order dessert so we have time.

mechanism: A treats annoyance and a request for silence at a post-breakup dinner as proof of remembered intimacy.
confusable: Unlike ignoring rejection, A must reinterpret each awkward exchange as the connection actively surviving.
comparison: D92-a turns explicit needs into intimacy and extends dessert time; D92-b turns canceled Fridays into mutual care.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
